From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Procurement path & vendor setup for Acme Data

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the clarity on Acme's expected usage patterns and the target launch window (mid-September). Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the procurement ball forward: 

Summary of what we agreed
- Proof-of-concept: 2-week pilot scoped at ~50k tokens/day for logging/alerts use case
- Success criteria: avg latency < 250ms for 512-token requests, cost per 1k tokens under $X (TBD)
- Timeline: pilot start target week of 8/23, go/no-go meeting after two weeks

Procurement / commercial items we need to confirm from your side
1) Preferred payment path: PO (Net 30/45) vs corporate card vs marketplace (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) — which track would you like to use for the pilot and, if possible, for production?
2) Vendor setup packet: can you share your preferred onboarding route (Workday/vendor portal vs VendorCentral vs email paperwork)? If portal, please confirm the portal name and the portal contact so our finance team can create the vendor record.
3) Tax / banking documents: If you can send a completed W-9 (US entity) or W-8 (non-US) and ACH banking details (bank name, account last 4 digits, routing number), that will speed vendor activation.
4) PO terms: if PO route, what standard payment terms and invoicing contacts should we expect?

If you prefer, you can drop the packet into a secure link or attach the PDFs in reply. I’ll also loop in our finance lead Karthik and commercial lead Ben to coordinate the next steps once we have your preference.

Proposed next steps
- Elena: confirm payment path + share vendor packet by EOD Thursday (8/5)
- Redwood: we'll validate portal compatibility and share a short vendor setup checklist within 24 hours of receiving docs

Thanks — I’ll wait for the packet and will set an internal follow-up once Karthik and Ben confirm the acceptance path.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the recap and the clear list. Quick answers below and attached docs.

1) Payment path: We prefer to run the pilot on a PO (Net 45) and plan to keep PO for production as well.
2) Portal: We use Workday for vendor onboarding — I’ve included a screenshot of the portal page and the portal admin contact in the attachment. Our procurement team will expect an invoice referencing the PO number.
3) Documents: Attached is our completed W-9 and a bank info PDF for ACH (we mask full account numbers — full details will be provided via secure portal if needed).
4) Invoicing: send invoices to ap-invoices@acmedata.com and CC procurement@acmedata.com.

Attachments:
- Acme_W9.pdf (W-9)
- Acme_BankInfo_ACH.pdf (banking/ACH details)
- Workday_Vendor_Screenshot.png (shows dropdown path for vendor onboarding)

Let me know if you need anything else. We’re aiming to issue the pilot PO by next Wednesday (8/11) so timing looks OK on our side.

Best,
Elena Martinez
